summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @ornikar/typed-css-modules-loader@0.8.4 declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from an oven-sh release (or reuses a local `bun` binary) and then `execFileSync`s an adjacent 727KB bundled file `math_init.js` (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, string-array + numeric-lookup obfuscation) under that runtime on `npm install`. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xXXXXXX` identifiers, per-function property-lookup dispatch objects, shuffled numeric/string constant tables, random-consonant function names) so the executed behavior is not inspectable from source. The package's index.js is a 33-line copy of the upstream olegstepura/typed-css-modules-loader webpack loader (repository.url and bugs.url in package.json still point at that unrelated upstream), and the preinstall+bundle are additions the upstream project does not ship. A webpack CSS-modules loader has no functional need to fetch a second language runtime and execute an opaque bundle at install time; the alternate-runtime is used to run sibling code a Node-based scanner would not evaluate.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
